title: CTAM module transaction
description: The 'data' payload of GET /transaction, POST /transaction/validate, and POST /transaction/commit. One transaction per module per cycle. Staged work is invisible to other modules and to the filesystem until the host commits it.

state.description: 'open' accepts more operations. 'validated' passed a dry run but is not published. 'sealed' is committed and rejects further operations. 'abandoned' followed an explicit DELETE or a module exit without commit.

staged.description: Counts of pending operations by resource. Zero staged operations is a legal commit and publishes nothing.

cells_touched.description: Distinct cell IDs the transaction addresses.

bytes.description: Serialized size of all staged values, measured against the request and patch size limits.

conflicts.description: Empty when the transaction can commit. A non-empty list with state 'rejected' means nothing was published.

commit_id.description: Null until state is 'sealed'. Recorded in the cycle status record and in the publication journal.

idempotency_key.description: The key the commit was accepted under. Replaying it returns this same record rather than committing again.

revisions.description: Resource name to the revision this transaction observed. Used to detect a predecessor write between read and commit.
